faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting the WB Police Driver recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by West Bengal Police Telecommunication (WB Police) for hiring qualified candidates for contractual driver positions within their department.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment drive is Driver under the West Bengal Police Telecommunication department.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available under WB Police Driver Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Driver post in this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for WB Police Driver?
faq.answer: The mode of application is strictly Offline. Candidates need to fill out the offline application form and deposit it in the designated drop box or send it as instructed.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the completed offline application form for the WB Police Driver recruitment is 16-10-2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the educational qualification required for the Driver post?
faq.answer: Candidates must be Class 10 pass with knowledge in Bengali/English/Hindi reading/writing and must possess a valid driving license for LMV with at least 3 years of driving experience.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for WB Police Driver Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit for applicants is between 21 to 40 years as on 01/10/2026. Please check the notification for any category-specific rules if applicable.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary offered for the Driver post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Driver post will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 16,000/- per month on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q9. Where should the filled application form be deposited?
faq.answer: The application should be addressed to the Additional Director General of Police, Telecommunication, WB and deposited in the Drop Box at M. T. Section, Telecommunication HQ, WB, 3, M. B. Sarani, Kolkata 700 040.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises screening of applications, a driving test, an interview, and a final medical test conducted by the department.
